hypothesis.statement: The two ours-only `mr` (@0x5e0, @0x678), the ours-only `addi` (@0x22c) and the four target-only `addi rX,r31,3136` (@0x334, @0x464, @0x1174 and the second half of @0x5dc) are ONE mechanism: ours caches `potionicon_tab + 0xC40` in a callee-saved register for the whole function and copies it per region, while the target re-materializes it from r31 at each region. Ours therefore saves SEVENTEEN GPRs (`stmw r15,140(r1)`, frame 264) against the target's SIXTEEN (`stmw r16,136(r1)`, frame 256), and per claim.law.direct-global-member-flips-index-base-association the extra saved register IS the cached web. The untried lever is therefore NOT a respelling of the PT/PTA macros (measured dead three ways this run) but a reduction of do_players' long-lived local set by one, so MWCC has no spare callee-saved register to hold the web: the candidates are `it` and `best`, both initialised at lines 1685-1686 and not read again until lines 1815-1817 and 2061, i.e. live across the entire function for no reason a 2001 author would have needed.
